exact_statement: For every conformal p-value on the stated finite-rank theorem domain, the P2E conversion is set-preserving: p > alpha if and only if F(p) < 1/alpha.
assumptions: p is supported on the conformal rank grid {1/(n+1), ..., 1}
the exact mean-one positive sigmoid construction is used
success_criteria: zero membership mismatches in all 18 predeclared theorem-domain cells
classic log, square-root, and linear controls inflate sets
